streaming_input.text: Start by creating a unique strong password and storing it in the approved password manager.
Next, enable multifactor authentication; then verify recovery details and secure recovery codes offline
. Monitor alerts and sessions, and if compromise is suspected, contact the Service Desk
Multifactor authentication does. It requires an additional factor, so obtaining or guessing
the password alone is insufficient for access.
